Business's physical address must be in AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, MD, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV, or DC.

New Truist business checking client only — the business cannot have an existing Truist business checking account or have closed one within 365 days prior to the promotion start date with the same TIN.

$400 tier: deposit at least $2,500 within 30 days AND maintain a daily Current Balance of at least $2,500 from day 30 through day 90. $800 tier: same with $10,000. If the $10,000 balance dips, you can still earn the $400 tier if the $2,500 level holds.
Minimum opening deposit is $100 (refundable principal, not a fee).
Truist Dynamic Business Checking has a $25 monthly maintenance fee, waivable with a $5,000 average combined balance over three months in Truist business accounts.
Bonus is paid within 10 business days after Truist verifies the requirements; the $800 reward is paid as two separate $400 deposits.
Account must remain open, unrestricted, with a positive balance at payout — otherwise the reward is forfeited.
Truist may report the reward to the IRS; taxes are the recipient's responsibility.
Truist reserves the right to deny payout for offers claimed through unaffiliated third-party websites — enroll only via Truist's own promotion page.
